description: First-wave compatibility exceptions for seven root Knowledge leaves plus the neutral technical data leaf. P0b froze the first revision at 0da7e2f960cd4ec994ae8eddea5b71023c5379ca and K01 re-recorded every leaf hash before the code move. This K02 revision changes only the neutral data leaf's locked file hash, because the pack.json resource moved to the Harness root. It is not a wildcard approval and changes only through formal review. D018/D020 chose these exact edges. file_sha256 is the old root leaf before the move, and line references are at the recorded base_commit.

revision_history.reason: #389 (c013e7778e5d421df655b969d4c89f81ade65b44) changed two leaves after P0b. #393 changed none of the seven leaves. The five other hashes are unchanged.

K02 (#409) moves repo_packs/<pack>/pack.json to the Harness resource root per D007, so the neutral data leaf reads a new physical path and its locked file hash changes. The seven root leaf hashes, the nine compatibility pairs and catalog's two routes are unchanged.

resource_path_revision.reason: D007 places repo_packs/<pack>/pack.json under the Harness resource root. The leaf is the only reader of that resource, so its one path expression moves with the file.
resource_path_revision.unchanged: The importlib anchor stays files("inferrsi") and joins the physical path, so the leaf still imports no inferrsi module. allowed_imports, the two symbols, the top-level shape, REPO_TYPES object identity and the two permitted importers are unchanged, and infra gains no edge into Harness.
resource_path_revision.review: This manifest revision requires formal architecture review (amy-why-3459 and zengchuang-hw). The implementer does not self-approve it.

infra_inspection_rewrite.note: K01 changes only this import line. Original functions, injected parameters, and returns stay the same. current_import records the line at base_commit.

intra_closure_note: An import of inferrsi._repo_pack_data from inside inferrsi.knowledge (for example inferrsi/knowledge/catalog.py) is intra-closure, not a tenth compatibility exception; it is governed by the leaf's no-inferrsi.*-import rule and by REPO_TYPES object identity, not by this allowlist.
